answer: Each submission needs cosignature from 3 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 33 submissions per epoch. Cosignatures are collected in crystal, verified in signal, and relic names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Every extra alias adds 3 hours of verification and 6 percent more locked value. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
